messages:
jess_cust: Hey support — customer saw SSE stream cut mid-response when switching from 5G to hotel WiFi. They got a partial payload but were billed for full response, customer wants refund and workaround.

sam: Can you share SDK version and client logs (socket close code / http status)?

jess_cust: SDK js v1.4.2
Logs:
  CONNECT start 2026-03-15T18:03:12Z
  SSE: got chunk id=12 "...the quick brown"
  NETWORK: switch 5G -> WiFi
  SOCKET: read timeout, client socket closed (ECONNRESET)
  RESPONSE: partial body, no final event

Steps to repro:
 1) Start a long stream (~800 tokens)
 2) Force mobile -> WiFi handoff (toggle WiFi / airplane)
 3) Client reports error and reconnects, output stops midstream

alexa: Billing note: partial deliveries usually billed to last delivered token; I'll ping billing to verify and refund if incorrect. Infra note: could be client-initiated close during NAT/port churn. Check LB/proxy timeouts and keepalives.

mike: Infra: recent proxy change shortened idle_timeout. Mobile carriers' NAT churn can reset connections. Mitigations:
 - server: emit SSE comments as keepalive (": keepalive\n\n") every 15s
 - client: avoid hard abort on ECONNRESET, attempt resume
 - platform: support ephemeral session IDs so clients can request resume from offset

jess_cust: Any recommended resume header for JS SDK v1.x?

mike: Example flow:
 - server returns header `x-rw-session: abc123` on initial stream
 - on reconnect client sends `X-RW-RESUME: abc123; offset=382`
 - server replies with remaining tokens or 409 if session expired
curl -H "X-RW-RESUME: abc123; offset=382" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams

deploy-bot: infra-deploy 2026-03-16T02:12:01Z applied: proxy idle_timeout changed 60s -> 30s (deploy-447)

sam: That deploy might explain regressions. Action items:
 - infra to evaluate rolling rollback or bump keepalive + idle_timeout
 - eng/sdk to add reconnect+resume example in JS SDK (sam to track)
 - billing to verify charges and issue refunds if warranted

jess_cust: Passing to customer; any immediate client patch suggestions?

mike: Quick client-side patches:
 - send SSE comment keepalives every 10-15s
 - on ECONNRESET wait 200-500ms then reconnect with exponential backoff
 - log `x-rw-session` header and include `X-RW-CLIENT-VERSION` in requests

alexa: I'll open escalation ticket and tag infra + billing. Keeping this thread for notes.

sam: Created ticket SUP-5421, P2 until infra confirms. Thanks :thumbsup:
